welcome.eyebrow: Docs that ship with your repo
welcome.headline: Where documentation takes shape
welcome.lead: Pagenary turns a git repo of Markdown into a fast, searchable, SEO-ready docs site you host yourself — for next to nothing. This portal is built by Pagenary, from Pagenary's own docs.
pillars: Free to host — every site is plain static files; deploy to any free static host or CDN.
Batteries included — ranked search, SEO, diagrams, theming, and export, with no plugins to wire up.
Just a git repo and a tool — your docs are versioned files: no server, no database, no SaaS bill.
checklist: Read the Quickstart to build your first site.
Write your docs in Markdown (or HTML/JS).
Deploy the static output to any free static host.
welcome.quote: Real docs from a git repo — host them yourself, for next to nothing.
